title: A unified approach to the Dirac fine structures on the $S$-spectrum and a connection with Gegenbauer polynomials
summary: This paper contributes to the recently introduced theory of fine structures on the $S$-spectrum. We study, in a unified way, the functional calculi for axially Poly-Analytic-Harmonic functions on the $S$-spectrum. Axially Poly-Analytic-Harmonic functions of type $(β, m)$, for $β, m \in \mathbb{N}_0$ belong to the kernel of the Dirac-Laplace operators $D^βΔ^m$ of type $(β, m)$ and contain as particular cases axially Poly-Analytic and axially Poly-Harmonic functions.
